items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I remember when I started with Bonnie Rao

ctx.x: I've played some tough shows, I'm telling you boys, and you only get one crack at them when you play these conventions. They come right down from New York, they spend a million dollars to fly them here and everything else, but they don't give you any extra. You've got to get it before you start, that's all I want to tell you. And some of the music, terrific arrangements. I mean the biggest bands don't play an arrangement without rehearsing it, do they? No. I remember when I started with Bonnie Rao, his brother…
